output.title: New `ciss` short name for ClusterIssuer is a convenience addition
output.content: The change only adds the `ciss` short name for the `ClusterIssuer` resource. The only installed CRD listed is certificates.cert-manager.io, and the manifests show only apps/v1 Deployment and cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate. Nothing shown depends on ClusterIssuer short names, and existing resources are not described as changing.
